# Sharing Requirements Checklist: Sharing & Invitations (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 013 — secret handling and privacy, offline discipline of invitations versus online-only membership actions, plan gating, access-loss purge, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): security/privacy of invitation secrets and links first, then the purge and role-gating guarantees, then contract fidelity and UX completeness; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, plan, research or contracts in the same session; each says where. Unchecked items were reviewed and hold; they stay open for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified whether an owner may invite to an archived wallet? [Gap → fixed: FR-001 "Invite is offered for active wallets only"]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified what happens to an invitation created for a wallet that the server has not accepted yet? [Gap → fixed: FR-001 "waits until the wallet is accepted"; research R-03 prerequisites]
- [x] CHK003 Is withdrawing an invitation that was never sent defined (no request)? [Gap → fixed: FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is the held link forgotten when its invitation is withdrawn? [Gap → fixed: FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Are `RATE_LIMITED` and `FORBIDDEN` answers to a queued create specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 Is the join flow defined when the first wallet read after joining fails or is offline? [Gap → fixed: FR-013 "Try again"]
- [x] CHK007 Is leaving the signed-out invitation screen defined (kept or dropped)? [Gap → fixed: FR-011 "leaving that screen keeps it held"]
- [x] CHK008 Is the moment a pending invitation turns "Expired" on an open screen defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-016 "re-evaluated at least once a minute"]
- [x] CHK009 Is the member name used when a member set no display name specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-016 reuses the spec 006 wording]
- [ ] CHK010 Are all eleven backend operations either used or explicitly listed as not used? [Completeness, Spec §5 "Not used"]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for every activity `action` and `subject_type` in the contract enum? [Completeness, FR-025, contracts/ui-and-e2e.md copy]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the access-loss purge defined for each of the four signals (user-feed tombstone, leave 200, leave 404, wallet-feed 404)? [Completeness, FR-019, FR-023]

- [ ] CHK014 Is the accepted link format specified precisely (scheme, host, port per flavor, path, token alphabet and length)? [Clarity, FR-009, research R-08]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "never shown" for the link reconciled with sharing it (share sheet and clipboard only, no on-screen text)? [Clarity, FR-005, US3-S1]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the uniform "can't be opened" message required for every `NOT_FOUND` cause, with no variant per cause? [Clarity, FR-014, US2-S6]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the order of the invite gate checks specified (verified → sharing included → people count)? [Clarity, FR-002]
